upstream.description: Quick, painless, intuitive OCR platform written in Rust and TypeScript. Modern UI with modern API, with an emphasis on intuitive user experience.

classification.analysis: Readur is a self-hostable document management system written in Rust (Axum backend) with a React/TypeScript frontend, offering OCR-based text extraction (Tesseract, multi-language), full-text PostgreSQL search, WebDAV/S3/local-folder sync, labels, folder watching, and OIDC/SSO auth. It's aimed at individuals and teams wanting a Paperless-ngx-style document archive with a modern UI, Docker/Helm deployment, and an API-first design with Swagger docs. Actively developed, with dedicated Claude Code review agents in the repo for OCR, storage-sync, and testing workflows.

use_cases.title: Self-host an OCR document archive with full-text search
Sync documents in from WebDAV, S3, or a watched folder
Replace Paperless-ngx with a Rust-backed alternative
Search scanned multi-language documents by content
